title: Glowing top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="halo" cx="50" cy="50" r="50" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00ffee" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#00ffee" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hatBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2a2f6e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a1d4a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="brimGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1a1d4a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0d0f33"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow halo behind hat -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="42" ry="42" fill="url(#halo)"/>

  <!-- Brim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="38" ry="10" fill="url(#brimGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="38" ry="10" fill="none" stroke="#4a55cc" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="36" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#5a66dd" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Hat body -->
  <path d="M22 72 Q22 32 24 22 Q26 14 34 14 L66 14 Q74 14 76 22 Q78 32 78 72 Z" fill="url(#hatBody)"/>

  <!-- Hat side highlight -->
  <path d="M24 72 Q24 34 26 23 Q27 16 33 16 L40 16 Q34 20 33 30 Q30 50 30 72 Z" fill="#4a55cc" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Hat band -->
  <path d="M23 58 Q50 64 77 58 L77 64 Q50 70 23 64 Z" fill="#7b4fd6"/>
  <path d="M23 58 Q50 64 77 58" fill="none" stroke="#a07aee" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Band buckle/gem -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="3" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="2" fill="#ffee99"/>

  <!-- Top rim of hat -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="14" rx="26" ry="5" fill="#3a4090"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="14" rx="26" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#6a77ee" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Glowing shine lines -->
  <path d="M34 28 Q38 32 36 44" fill="none" stroke="#7b8aff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 30 Q64 36 65 46" fill="none" stroke="#7b8aff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <path d="M80 30 L82 34 L86 34 L83 37 L84 41 L80 38 L76 41 L77 37 L74 34 L78 34 Z" fill="#88ffff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M16 42 L17 45 L20 45 L18 47 L19 50 L16 48 L13 50 L14 47 L12 45 L15 45 Z" fill="#88ffff" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#aaffff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="18" r="1" fill="#aaffff" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
